gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gruppo: Distinctive from the first glance, Sniglet draws its rounded display letters in a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, while Gruppo is the plain sans beneath. Sniglet makes noise; Gruppo keeps quiet.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-host-grotesk: Commanding but gentle, Sniglet draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. Host Grotesk sweeps its curves open beneath it, and that easy, outward lean is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Steady pen pressure from first letter to last gives Sniglet its look, rounded and quietly forceful. And IBM Plex Sans Thai, a sans-serif with open pincer-like c shapes, makes the pairing feel modern and uncluttered.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-inclusive-sans: Chunky, friendly, and a bit bold in attitude, Sniglet heads this pair with a level, unaccented beat. And Inclusive Sans follows with round letters whose rims match their stems, so every curve stays open-ended.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-istok-web: Flat, single-weight linework with no thick-thin modulation is what defines Sniglet, and it gives the heading a blunt charm. Istok Web, a sans-serif of rounded letters with a clearly open side, stays approachable across a whole page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-jura: Rounded, level, and quietly loud, Sniglet leads. And Jura follows with strokes as constant as bent wire and s curves open wide at both ends, a crisp counterweight to that soft heading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kanchenjunga: Sniglet's rounded terminals and level, unaccented beat make it unmistakable up top. But Kanchenjunga holds the lower ground, with a drafting-pen line and shapes that never clog at low resolution.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kantumruy-pro: Sniglet is the one with a quiet, level beat and no accents of weight, rounded and unmistakable at the top. And Kantumruy Pro, a plain sans with an e opening clearly to the right, runs hairline-free and swell-free down the page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kodchasan: Loud rounded letters with a level, unaccented beat give Sniglet a commanding look, and Kodchasan sits below as the plain sans with hanging-open terminals. Sniglet is best at announcing; Kodchasan is best at carrying on without calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-koho: KoHo brings wide c apertures and a neutral, clean plain sans voice to the body. Then Sniglet's flat, single-weight linework above it makes the pair's strongest quality its plain, uncomplicated clarity.
